# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_TO_VWAP_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps up at open but fails to sustain above VWAP with bearish EMA ribbon alignment (8<21<55), the gap tends to fade intraday, offering a short opportunity. This edge exists because initial gap momentum often lacks follow-through when VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance and ribbon alignment confirms bearish structure, trapping late gap-chasers.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Define gap up as open > prior day's close + 0.2%. If gap occurs, monitor 3-min bars for price retracing to within 0.1%0.1% of VWAP while 8-EMA < 21-EMA < 55-EMA (bearish ribbon) and bar closes below VWAP. Enter short at close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Stop at gap high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1×ATR risk from entry, runner trailed by 10% of lowest-since-entry price.  
**Regime filters:** Only trade when VIX 15-25 and opening range width > 0.5×ATR (genuine gap). Avoid if VIX >30 (strong pre-momentum).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% headline P&L (per position sizing schedule in risk-rules.md).
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed trigger would be tested on 16-month SPY 5m dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection based on gap-up definition and VWAP/ribbon confluence with only 6 anchor days for validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated against realistic OPRA simulator).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: gap continuation instead of fade (e.g., strong trend day) causing stop-out at gap high; max drawdown scenario: consecutive gap-up fade failures during low-VIX chop; blow-up scenario: volatility explosion (VIX>40) invalidating regime filters causing multiple unfiltered losses.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days drive >50% of P&L, strategy is fragile).
